title: Yang-Mills Theory and the Mass Gap
description: We prove a mass gap for four-dimensional lattice Yang-Mills theory with any compact simple gauge group at strong coupling, and we prove that one uniform estimate on cubes of fixed physical size gives every continuum limit a mass gap. That estimate along the weak-coupling tuning and a nontrivial four-dimensional continuum construction remain open.
